description: Server-derived account-scope invariant. The server derives the account from @request.auth.id (PocketBase) or pb_auth.current_user (runner); clients never choose or override ownership. This file is the rule table every account-scoped collection must satisfy. A leaf that changes a listed rule or adds a user-owned collection edits its row in the same PR. Read by harness/probes, #172 (authorization matrix), and #1's security inventory.

list.guarantee: owner-filtered list; another account's rows are absent

view.guarantee: another account's record is not found

update.guarantee: another account's or an anonymous update is not found

delete.guarantee: another account's record is not found and is unchanged

oversized_input.guarantee: a JSON field over its maxSize fails validation

signup_disabled.guarantee: signup is rejected when ROUNDS_DISABLE_SIGNUPS is set

create_foreign_owner.guarantee: a create whose user is not the caller is rejected

update_reassign.guarantee: an update that reassigns user is not found under the owner rule

server_only.guarantee: a client create or update on a server-only collection is forbidden

update_own.guarantee: an account's update of its own row succeeds

server_derivation.superuser_bypass: superuser requests and $app.dao() writes bypass collection rules; hook routes and the public view-tracking insert rely on this

account-scope.list.cross-account.isolate.guarantee: a signed-in account's list never returns another account's rows

account-scope.list.anonymous.isolated.guarantee: an anonymous list returns none of an account's rows

account-scope.view.cross-account.denied.guarantee: a signed-in account cannot read another account's record by id

account-scope.view.anonymous.denied.guarantee: an anonymous caller cannot read an account's record by id

account-scope.update.cross-account.denie.guarantee: a signed-in account cannot update another account's record

account-scope.update.anonymous.denied.guarantee: an anonymous caller cannot update an account's record

account-scope.delete.cross-account.denie.guarantee: a signed-in account cannot delete another account's record

account-scope.delete.anonymous.denied.guarantee: an anonymous caller cannot delete an account's record

account-scope.create.anonymous.denied.guarantee: an anonymous caller cannot create a row

account-scope.oversized-input.rejected.guarantee: a JSON field larger than its maxSize is rejected

account-scope.signup.disabled.denied.guarantee: signup is rejected when the instance disables signups

account-scope.create.foreign-owner.denie.guarantee: a create whose user is not the caller is rejected

account-scope.update.reassign-owner.deni.guarantee: an update that reassigns a row to another account is rejected

account-scope.update.own.accepted.guarantee: an account's update of its own row (omitting user or resending its own) still succeeds

account-scope.create.server-only.denied.guarantee: a client create on a server-only collection is forbidden

account-scope.update.server-only.denied.guarantee: a client update on a server-only collection is forbidden

account-scope.create.superuser.accepted.guarantee: the superuser view-tracking insert still succeeds
